Type: dresser
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Kingston Modern Dresser 19.69"W, White
Colors: White
Materials: Hardwood
The striking texture of this engineered hardwood end table is balanced by its simple color scheme: pure white with gold accents on the handles and feet. The 2 drawers provide more than enough storage for your bedside. 15.75"W x 19.69"D x 23.23"H Engineered hardwood and fiberboard; metal legs Features textured detailing on front of drawers with gold accents on handles and feet. Two drawers for maximized storage next to couch or bed; side-mounted ball-bearing drawer slides and gold hand pulls. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
